name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold explorer focused on acquiring and exploring mineral properties and royalty interests concentrated in Nevada, with one property in Idaho. The company's primary focus is the Lapon Canyon Gold Project in Nevada, where a 2026 reverse circulation drill program returned significant gold intercepts. Nevada Canyon is in the exploration stage with a portfolio of unpatented mining claims across multiple Nevada districts including the Carlin Trend.
